_comment: JAG realm WebAuthn policy patch. Apply via: PATCH /admin/realms/jag (or merge into full realm export).
_note_rpId: rpId MUST match the domain used by the browser when authenticating. Change 'localhost' to 'jagcorporate.com' for production BEFORE any user registers a device. The rpId is bound to the credential at registration time and cannot be changed afterwards.

_policy_decisions.authenticatorAttachment: platform — built-in biometrics only (Touch ID, Windows Hello, Face ID). Cross-platform hardware keys (YubiKey) excluded deliberately. The platform default is suitable for a private owner portal where all devices are known.
_policy_decisions.userVerificationRequirement: required — the user must prove presence AND identity to their device (biometric or PIN). A bare hardware key tap is not sufficient.
_policy_decisions.requireResidentKey: No for standard WebAuthn (2FA). Yes for passwordless — the credential must be stored on the authenticator so the user can log in without typing a username.
_policy_decisions.attestationConveyancePreference: none — we do not verify device provenance. The JAG platform is a private single-owner system; attestation adds complexity without meaningful security gain here.
_policy_decisions.rpId_production: Must be set to the actual domain (jagcorporate.com) before users register. The browser enforces that credentials registered against jagcorporate.com cannot be used from localhost and vice versa.
